text: Debugging is an important skill for every programmer. When a program does not work correctly, the first step is identifying bugs by reading error messages and testing different parts of the code. Good debugging tools, such as breakpoints and step-by-step execution, help you find where problems happen. It is also important to follow a systematic approach: change one thing at a time and check the result before trying something else. Logging is another useful strategy, because log messages show what the program was doing before it crashed. With patience and clear thinking, most bugs can be found and fixed quickly.
